title: More Rain
description: This pack makes it rain more often for those who love rain just like me!
body:
🌧️ More Rain Datapack


Do you love stormy skies and rainy vibes?
This datapack makes it rain much more often than in vanilla Minecraft, creating a wetter, moodier, and cozier atmosphere. Perfect for building, survival, or roleplay worlds where rain is part of the immersion.

✨ Features

✔️ Rain happens more frequently than vanilla
✔️ Lightweight — no mods required
✔️ Works in singleplayer & multiplayer
✔️ Fully vanilla-friendly

📥 Installation

Download the .zip file.

Place it into your world’s datapacks folder:

.minecraft/saves/<your_world>/datapacks/


Open your world and run:

/reload
/function more_rain:setup


That’s it — the world will now have more frequent rain! 🌧️

⚙️ How It Works

Every ~10 seconds, the datapack checks the weather.

With a 33% chance, it forces a short rain.

Result: rain comes around much more often than normal.

(You can tweak the rain duration or chance by editing check_weather.mcfunction if you want even stormier worlds.)

✅ Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21+

Works in 1.20.6 if you change pack_format in pack.mcmeta to 15

Works on both singleplayer and servers

Safe to add/remove anytime
